summary.text: Ted Nordblum is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He ran for the same seat in 2024, when he lost to Democratic incumbent Jacqui Irwin.

paragraphs.text: Nordblum was born in Buffalo, New York, and graduated from Rim of the World High School.
His career experience includes working as owner of Titan Medical, as a heavy equipment operator, actor, voice actor, bartender, sales representative and in construction.
Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with the Operating Engineers Union.
